notes: Get a T-casual 10-ride metro ticket; the Aerobús from Plaça Catalunya takes 35 minutes. The city is walkable, and Montjuïc has a cable car and funicular.
Sagrada Família, Park Güell, Casa Batlló, Picasso: timed online tickets are ESSENTIAL. For the Sagrada Família, book months ahead because of the 2026 centenary.
Winter is sunny at 10-15°C with no crowds. December brings the Christmas market (Fira de Santa Llúcia), January the sales; the Font Màgica is limited in winter.
The set lunch (menú del día) costs 13-18 EUR, about half the price of dinner. Standing at tapas bars is cheap. Dinner starts after 21:00.
Pickpocketing on the Rambla and the metro is among the worst in Europe: keep your bag in front and never leave your phone on the table.
Catalan and Spanish are spoken; 'bon dia' is enough. For a tip, round up the bill.

stops.name: Sagrada Família
stops.tips: Gaudí's basilica. Book timed tickets online weeks ahead (centenary year 2026, 26-40 EUR); the tower costs extra. At 09:00 the light hits the stained glass.

stops.name: Casa Batlló
stops.tips: The house with the dragon-back roof. Book online, morning slot.

stops.name: Casa Milà La Pedrera
stops.tips: Admire the wavy façade from outside; the interior is an optional 28 EUR.

stops.name: Cerveseria Catalana
stops.tips: Classic Eixample tapas bar. Try the montaditos (small open sandwiches) and gambas (prawns); the queue is short at 13:30.

stops.name: Passeig de Gràcia
stops.tips: Modernist boulevard lined with shops.

backups.name: Tapas 24
backups.tips: Carles Abellan's tapas bar; try the bikini sandwich.

backups.name: Recinte Modernista Sant Pau
backups.tips: Modernist hospital complex near the Sagrada Família; a calmer alternative to Batlló.

stops.name: Barcelona Cathedral
stops.tips: Gothic cathedral with a cloister courtyard of geese. Free mass hours in the morning.

stops.name: Barri Gòtic Streets
stops.tips: Plaça Sant Felip Neri, the Roman columns (MUHBA Temple d'August, free) and the Bisbe bridge.

stops.name: La Boqueria
stops.tips: Market on the Rambla. Eat squid with eggs at the El Quim or Bar Pinotxo counter; best before 10:00.

stops.name: Santa Maria del Mar
stops.tips: The Cathedral of the Sea; plain, pure Gothic.

stops.name: Picasso Museum
stops.tips: Early-period Picasso. Free on Thursday evenings, book online.

backups.name: El Xampanyet
backups.tips: Serving cava and anchovies since 1929; standing room, next to the Picasso Museum.

backups.name: Palau de la Música Catalana
backups.tips: Tour of the Modernist concert hall; an alternative to the Picasso Museum.

stops.name: Park Güell
stops.tips: Mosaic salamander and the wavy bench. Timed online tickets (10 EUR); the 08:30 first slot is quiet.

stops.name: Bunkers del Carmel
stops.tips: Former anti-aircraft hill; Barcelona's best free 360° view.

stops.name: Plaça del Sol, Gràcia
stops.tips: Village-feel neighbourhood with squares and terraces.

stops.name: La Pubilla
stops.tips: Catalan set lunch in Gràcia; closed on Sundays.

stops.name: Casa Vicens
stops.tips: Gaudí's first house in Gràcia, with tile and palm-leaf motifs.

backups.name: Bar Bodega Quimet Gràcia
backups.tips: Vermouth and tinned-seafood tapas; a local spot.

backups.name: Hospital de Sant Pau
backups.tips: Modernist hospital; an alternative to Casa Vicens.

stops.name: MNAC Museu Nacional
stops.tips: Romanesque frescoes in a palace building. Enjoy the city view from the steps; the terrace is free.

stops.name: Fundació Joan Miró
stops.tips: Works by Miró in Sert's white building.

stops.name: Montjuïc Cable Car
stops.tips: Cable car up to the castle, with sea views.

stops.name: Montjuïc Castle Café
stops.tips: Lunch in the castle courtyard with a view of the harbour.

stops.name: Poble Espanyol
stops.tips: A replica town of Spanish villages with craft workshops; the fountain is switched off.

backups.name: Quimet & Quimet
backups.tips: Legendary tinned-seafood tapas bar in Poble Sec; standing only.

backups.name: Montjuïc Olympic Stadium
backups.tips: The 1992 stadium; an alternative to the cable car.

stops.name: Barceloneta Beach
stops.tips: Winter beach walk and cycling, with surfers on the water.

stops.name: La Cova Fumada
stops.tips: Birthplace of the bomba (potato croquette). No menu, cash only, full by 13:00.

stops.name: Barceloneta Seafront to W Hotel
stops.tips: Palm-lined seafront walk, ending at Frank Gehry's fish sculpture.

stops.name: Port Vell and Maremagnum
stops.tips: The old harbour and the Rambla de Mar bridge.

stops.name: Transbordador Aeri del Port
stops.tips: Red cable car across the harbour to Montjuïc, with sea and city views.

backups.name: Can Paixano
backups.tips: Cava and sandwiches; standing only, cheap.

backups.name: Museu d'Història de Catalunya
backups.tips: History museum in a harbour warehouse, with a terrace café.

stops.name: Montserrat Monastery
stops.tips: Train plus rack railway takes 1.5 hours (about 50 EUR combined ticket). The Black Madonna sits in the saw-toothed mountain; the boys' choir (Escolania) sings at 13:00.

stops.name: Sant Joan Funicular
stops.tips: Funicular to the summit, with walking trails.

stops.name: Sant Joan Walk, Montserrat
stops.tips: A flat 1-hour walk among the rocks with views over Catalonia.

stops.name: Restaurant Abat Cisneros
stops.tips: Restaurant of the monastery hotel; Catalan lunch.

stops.name: Montserrat Market Stalls
stops.tips: Mató (fresh goat's cheese) and honey from farmers' stalls.

backups.name: Santa Cova
backups.tips: Path to the cave where the Virgin was found; an alternative to Sant Joan.

days.theme: Rambla morning and a gentle goodbye

stops.name: La Rambla
stops.tips: Walk the Rambla before the crowds arrive, past the Miró mosaic and the flower stalls.

stops.name: Palau Güell
stops.tips: Gaudí's city palace, with rooftop chimneys.

stops.name: Granja Viader
stops.tips: Hot chocolate and churros since 1870; the dairy where Cacaolat was born.

stops.name: Plaça Reial
stops.tips: Palm-filled square with Gaudí lamp posts. Take a farewell photo, then catch the Aerobús at Plaça Catalunya.

backups.name: MACBA
backups.tips: Contemporary art and skateboarders; an alternative to Palau Güell.
